song.name: The First Stand
song.plot: The Legion of Souls reaches Seraphina and Valen. With the Nythorian rebels, they make their stand against a tide they cannot hold. Their introduction to the saga — defenders of what remains of Nythoria, ground held against the dark.
song.analysis: New song, written lore-first. POV: Seraphina and Valen (duet-friendly), Nythorian resistance fighters, first person plural "we". Their saga introduction. Anchors: Nythoria, Ravenspire (the ancestral ruins — their home/ground), the resistance, the Legion of Souls, holding ground against the dark. Seraphina and Valen named. No founding-the-resistance plot (that is Vows of Silence, Era I) — they are already rebels; no Rift; no Anya; no Underworld; no "Queen" title. Structure: Verse 1 → Chorus → Verse 2 → Chorus → Bridge → Chorus. Mid-tempo defiant ballad-anthem. Suggested Suno direction: defiant, desperate, warm under the grim — anthem rock, battle drums, twin vocals.

section.name: Verse 1
section.reworked: [Intro: war drums, low horns] [Verse 1: twin vocals, steady build] The Legion rose beneath the blackened sky, And Ravenspire's old stones began to shake. We stood together, Seraphina and I, And swore we would not let the darkness take.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: [Chorus: anthemic, full band] We are the first stand, the unbroken line, We hold the ground where the shadows climb. Nythoria's last, we will not fall, We are the wall.

section.name: Verse 2
section.reworked: [Verse 2: defiant, climbing] The souls of the fallen march behind the dark, But we have fire that they cannot recall. Valen with his blade, Seraphina's spark, We are the embers that outlast the pall.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: [Chorus: anthemic, full band] We are the first stand, the unbroken line, We hold the ground where the shadows climb. Nythoria's last, we will not fall, We are the wall.

section.name: Bridge
section.reworked: [Bridge: stripped, twin vocals, the vow] The tide is endless, but so is the vow, We fight for what the darkness cannot drown. If we must fall, we fall upon this ground, And leave a light for all the ones unwound.

section.name: Chorus
section.reworked: [Chorus: massive, final stand] We are the first stand, the unbroken line, We hold the ground where the shadows climb. Nythoria's last, we will not fall, We are the wall.
